answer_1.quote: Recently, automated code documentation generation has been in the center of attention in language research, and quite a few advancements have been made in this field.
answer_1.outputs: Javadoc comments for Java code snippets

answer_2.quote: To assess the quality of the generated documentation, we employed a set of standard, well-established metrics. We used the BLEU score to measure the precision of n-gram overlap between the generated and reference documentation. Additionally, we used several variants of the ROUGE score (R-1, R-2, R-L, and R-Lsum) to evaluate content overlap by assessing recall on unigrams, bigrams, and the longest common subsequence.

answer_4.quote: Four volunteers, two software engineers, and two academic researchers, generously assisted with the manual verification process.
answer_4.guideline: We instructed annotators to remove entries containing documentation that was faulty, out-of-context, irrelevant or included personal information, and therefore did not accurately describe the corresponding code.
